Notes / Insights: SECONDARY KPI (Performance/Reliability). 95th-percentile response time of the /safe-to-spend endpoint. Target = under 200ms so the balance feels real-time inside the banking app; latency above this threshold risks user distrust of the number shown.

SECONDARY KPI (Performance/Adoption). % of Daily Active Users who view or interact with the Safe-to-Spend balance widget. Target = 40%+ DAU engagement within 60 days of launch — proxy for whether the feature actually changes user behavior, not just app opens.

PRIMARY KPI (Business Impact). % reduction in failed payments/accidental overdrafts among users with Safe-to-Spend enabled vs. a control cohort. Baseline captured at launch; target = 30% reduction within 90 days. Directly protects interchange revenue (fewer declined txns) and cuts 'Where did my money go?' support contacts.
